bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans affairs; appropriating money for a grant to Stillwater Veterans Memorial.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; VETERANS AFFAIRS; STILLWATER VETERANS MEMORIAL.

$350,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Stillwater Veterans Memorial to expand a veterans' memorial in Stillwater Veterans Memorial Park in the city of Stillwater. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: APPROPRIATION; VETERANS AFFAIRS; STILLWATER VETERANS MEMORIAL.
